lines.x: Euro area annual inflation picked up to 4.0% in October, driven by surging energy prices, paving the way for potential further European Central Bank rate hikes.
European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde announced plans to make currency swap lines more accessible to guard the euro area against external economic shocks and support the euro.

A global media investigation published findings from over 15 million leaked internal documents showing Deutsche Bank maintained lucrative business with sanctioned Russian figures and bypassed compliance warnings.
European stock indexes fell on Friday led by losses in technology shares, while European government bond yields dropped sharply as investors sought safer assets.
